failing_tests.detail: In commit 5d3cbde60, deploy exports in deploy_root_component were deduplicated in favor of with_dev_bff_runtime_env. However, test_openclaw_claude_oauth_token_reaches_the_deploy_export asserts that the exact line PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN="${PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN}" \ is present at least twice in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh (once for root deploy and once for bff-only rebuild). Deduplication reduced the count to 1, causing an assertion failure.

Similarly, the 5 dedicated dev login client ID exports were removed from the root deploy compose block in 5d3cbde60, dropping script.count(f'{compose_client_id}=') from 2 to 1 for VIEWER, APPROVER, RISK_OWNER, OPERATOR_A, and OPERATOR_B.

In 5d3cbde60, DEV_BFF_AUTH_READINESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and DEV_BFF_AUTH_READINESS_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS were consolidated into a dynamic bash loop in ssh_bash(). The contract test asserts exact string matching on command_prefix+=" PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_AUTH_READINESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=.
PUBLIC_HOST was also consolidated into the dynamic bash loop in ssh_bash(), breaking the exact string match assertion in scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_caddy_bootstrap_contract.py.
